summary: Simulated dictation control with a mirrored pixel spectrum and words that fade into focus; stopping collapses the bars to a point.

attributes.name: text
attributes.default: Make the trail grow out of the thumb toward the left and stop at three quarters of the track.
attributes.description: The sentence the simulated recognition types out, split on whitespace. Read each time listening starts.

events.name: transcript
events.description: Fires when listening stops, with the words recognised so far joined by spaces.

methods.description: Clears the transcript and starts the simulated listening. Ignored while the closing animation runs.
Stops listening and fires `transcript`. Only acts while listening. Removing the element ends a session without firing.

properties.name: sentence
properties.description: The sentence the simulated recognition types out; reflects the `text` attribute, or the default sentence when it is missing.

accessibility: The mic is a native button whose `aria-label` switches between "Start dictation" and "Stop dictation".
The transcript paragraph is an `aria-live="polite"` region, so recognised words are announced as they arrive.
The spectrum canvas is decorative and has `aria-hidden="true"`.
motion: With reduced motion, the mic's pulsing ring, the word fade-in and the idle wave are disabled and the status text swaps without the roll; the spectrum still follows the simulated voice while listening.
notes: No microphone is used. Audio levels are generated and the transcript is the `text` attribute revealed word by word; listening stops on its own 0.7 seconds after the last word.
The host carries `data-state="listening"` or `data-state="closing"` during those phases.

data.note: No microphone is used and the audio levels are generated; only the transcript can be set with `text`.
